headline: Bitcoin Falls To 83k From An 84k Open And Trades At The Session Low
narrative: Bitcoin fell to 83k from an 84k session open and is trading at the session low, which means the move through 84k did not hold. Ether last printed 2,437 against a 2,472 open, and Solana last printed 105.44 against a 106.92 open, so the decline ran across the complex, not in bitcoin alone. Open interest fell to 2.511 billion dollars from 2.618 billion dollars, which means leveraged positions were closed as spot left 84k.
author: jordan
